headline: Casio's new keyboard helps players avoid wrong notes with Feel Sync tech
summary: Casio has introduced a new keyboard feature called Feel Sync that lets players, including beginners, play along to songs without hitting a wrong note. The feature debuts on the new Casiotone CT-FS1, available now for $399.99, and is designed to help new musicians stay in tune while practicing.
